runtimeFlags: fp8 KV, MTP3 speculative, prefix caching on, gmu 0.90, ZE_AFFINITY_MASK single card
notes: Dense 27B on one Arc Pro B70. C1 decode = client-measured post-first-token stream rate, median of 9-10 measured samples at p512/g128 (15.8-19.1; p8192/g128 median 15.8); engine runs native MTP3 so this is a conservative lower bound on emitted tokens. Cold 8K prefill ~1,870 tok/s client-side. 150 W cap. Correctness: arithmetic canary PASS (sum i*i, i<4 -> 14), 8/10 executable-task battery. Capacity: the only measured single-B70 route holding the model's native 262,144-token context (fp8 KV pool ~287K tokens); a 261,920-token prompt was answered correctly. Functional codegen caveat: interactive-web battery 2/3 on the hard round (GLSL syntax error on raw WebGL2 prompt). Self-reported, E2.
